subject: Trial hosting & evaluation plan — Lumina Health
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Trial hosting & evaluation plan — Lumina Health

Alex — thanks for the great discussion today. Quick recap and recommended next steps to get the trial moving.

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Lumina's clinical summarization pipeline on PHI-like data; key readouts are latency under load, hallucination rate on test prompts, and per-API-unit cost.
- Priority success criteria (from your side): 1) <150ms median token latency for single-prompt summarization, 2) F1 >= 0.88 on entity extraction prompts, 3) clear audit logs for every inference, 4) documented data handling.

Hosting options we discussed (short pros/cons):
- Hosted (Redwood API): fastest onboarding, no infra ops for Lumina; best for quick baseline but doesn’t meet strict network isolation requirements.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool): predictable throughput and can isolate your tenant; easier than full VPC but still runs over managed network.
- VPC/private deployment: full network isolation and KMS/HSM integration; best fit for PHI and compliance but has lead time (network, routing, firewall rules) and requires your infra team for peering.

Recommendation (sales + SRE POV):
- Start with a 2-week Scoped Proof (hosted or dedicated sandbox) to validate functional acceptance and prompt sets.
- Parallel prep: begin VPC/network prep (if Lumina prefers VPC) so we can spin it up as a follow-on environment without re-running the entire eval.

Concrete next steps / asks
1) Please confirm hosting preference (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC) by EOD Wednesday so we can lock owners and timeline.
2) Share a representative sample dataset (anonymized or synthetic) and the top 10 validation prompts you want scored.
3) Security items: complete the short security questionnaire (link below) and confirm preferred KMS for key management if choosing VPC.
4) Proposed kickoff: week of Aug 16 for a lightweight 2-week functional trial; if you want VPC-first, we should target Aug 30 kickoff.

Attachments: lumina-data-flow.png (diagram), redwood-sla-draft.pdf (SLA stub)
Links: https://docs.redwood.ai/trial-checklist

I'll loop in Ben (solutions eng) and Priyom (AE) on timelines and provisioning.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park

Kim — thanks for the thorough recap. High level: Lumina prefers VPC for the trial because of internal compliance (PHI). That said, we understand the lead time. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Cost/effort delta: can you provide a short estimate for effort (days) and a delta in estimated monthly cost between Dedicated sandbox and VPC for a baseline config (approx. 4 qps, 32k tokens/day)?
2) Can you share SOC2 + any relevant penetration test summaries before we sign off?

Attached is a small sample schema (sample-patient-schema.csv) and our top 6 exemplar prompts. We can proceed with the Aug 16 quick-start only if Redwood confirms a hosted fallback (so development can begin) while VPC is provisioned.

Appreciate it — Alex

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Lumina trial — provisioning plan & owners (note: customer asked VPC-first)

Team — forwarding Alex’s preference: VPC-first but they want a hosted fallback so dev can begin. Proposing owners and immediate tasks below.

Owners
- AE / Customer liaison: Priyom Das (I’ll own procurement and timeline comms)
- Solutions eng / pre-sales: Kimberly Park (kickoff, prompt set, scoring)
- SRE / infra lead: Ben Carter (env provisioning, capacity sizing)
- Platform eng (VPC package): Vivek Kulkarni (peer review, KMS/HSM integration)

Immediate provisioning checklist (estimates):
- Hosted fallback setup: spin up rate-limited API keys & sample prompt harness (0.5 day).
- Dedicated sandbox sizing: reserve 1x A100-equivalent cluster; expected warm-up + validation: 1–2 days.
- VPC prep: networking design (2 days: peering, routes, firewall rules), KMS mapping and IAM (1 day), audit log pipeline (1 day). Assume total lead time = 5–8 business days after network/ops approval and firewall ticket.
- Security docs: attach SOC2 + pen-test summary to the customer (Ben, can you drop latest artifacts?).

Technical notes for sizing (from the call):
- Target sustained qps = 4; peak bursts to 12 qps for ingestion windows. Expect ~32k tokens/day; recommend caching short prefixes to reduce cost.
- Latency SLO: aim for p50 <150ms, p95 <500ms on dedicated hardware. VPC networking may add ~20–40ms depending on peering topology.

Action items (owners)
- Ben: prepare sandbox/dedicated cost delta (EOD Tue) + attach SOC2 artifacts.
- Vivek: outline VPC workplan and constraints for network team (EOD Wed).
- Kim: prepare trial success criteria doc (scoring harness, top-10 prompts) and send pre-kickoff checklist to Alex (tomorrow).
- Priyom: confirm procurement timeline with Lumina procurement and collect PO prerequisites.

Forwarding Alex’s note below for context.

Alex — thanks for confirming. Quick reply with concrete next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) We’ll run a hosted fallback (API key + dev harness) the week of Aug 16 so your ML devs can begin prompt tuning. That’s light ops and we’ll enforce strict rate limits.
2) Ben will send the sandbox vs VPC cost/effort delta by EOD Tuesday. Expect a short write-up (numbers + assumptions) and SOC2 + pen-test summary.
3) Vivek will share the VPC workplan for your network team by Wednesday. We’ll include the firewall and peering checklist.
4) Please review and sign the attached trial SOW (redwood-sla-draft.pdf) and upload any onboarding IP or IP restrictions via the HubSpot link.

Proposed kickoff: Aug 17 (hosted fallback onboarding). VPC provisioning tickets open on Aug 17 with target VPC-ready date Aug 27 (subject to Lumina network approvals). If that timeline works, we’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff on Aug 17 to walk through the checklist.

Pre-kickoff checklist (short)
- Confirm point of contact for network team + peering ticket owner
- Provide sample dataset location (S3 or secure share) and confirm anonymization approach
- Confirm SSO/SAML or SCIM requirements for developer access

Calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/kimberly/30min (pick Aug 17 or 18)

Thanks — looking forward.
